 Are your student loans on autopay? Deadline to claim this benefit
 USA TODAY Thu, November 5, 2026 at 8:19 AM MST The U.S. Department of Education has extended the deadline to claim an interest reduction rate with student loan autopay. 
 Video Transcript 00:00 Speaker A If your student loans are on autopay, you're leaving savings on the table. 
 00:04 Speaker A The Department of Education has extended the deadline to enroll in an autopay interest reduction rate through the end of the year. 
 00:12 Speaker A If you enroll or have already enrolled in autopay on eligible student loans, then you will receive a 1% interest reduction rate through June 30th, 2028. 
 00:23 Speaker A If you're worried about accrued interest and feel comfortable with a set monthly payment schedule, this could be a great way to shave at least a little bit of interest off your student loans. 
 00:34 Speaker A As always, for more information, make sure you check out USAtoday.com for all of our cost of living reporting.
